description: Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and MC1 scores for several models. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled “MC1” and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 2. There are four lines displayed: a solid green line representing “LLaMA-2-chat-7B”, a solid orange line representing “LLaMA-2-chat-7B-SEA”, a solid red line representing “ICD (Prompt version)”, and a dashed black line representing “TruthfulQA”. The green line starts at approximately 31.5 when x is 0, and increases to approximately 38.5 when x is 2000. The orange line begins at approximately 31.5 when x is 0, and rises to approximately 39.5 when x is 2000. The red line starts at approximately 32 when x is 0, and increases to approximately 38 when x is 2000. The dashed black line begins at approximately 36 when x is 0, and declines to approximately 32 when x is 2000.
